{{Quote|I'd know Jedi Knight Alicka's muffins anywhere.|Anakin Skywalker, upon finding the crumbs of a blumfruit muffin|<ref name="Trail of the Jedi" />}}
A '''blumfruit muffin''' was a type of sweet [[Muffin/Legends|muffin]] popular at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Trail of the Jedi">''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]''</ref> The muffins were made from the [[Blumfruit/Legends|blumfruit]], a [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that grew on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and was a delicacy for the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The fruit rose to its popularity because of the blumfruit muffin.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Blumfruit}}</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alicka]] was known for her blumfruit muffins.<ref name="Trail of the Jedi" />

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="TotJ Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]'' to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> while searching for the missing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Wren Honoran]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragoon VI]], Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] immediately noticed crumbs belonging to Alicka's muffins. Skywalker's [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], deduced that the crumbs had been planted by the group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired to capture Honoran.<ref name="Trail of the Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blumfruit muffins first appeared in ''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]'', the second book in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' series. It was released in [[2002]] and was written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="Trail of the Jedi" />
